frame: Blender tile frame (hex centre origin, +z up, chip socket (0, 1.5, 0.26)); file = glTF frame (x, z=-y); yaws CCW about Blender +z == about three.js +y

keep.note: clip = remove only the triangles the town covers, never the whole dune; the desert base is already 3643 tris, so drop in budget_drop_order until the tile is under 3634
the crop bands are ground materials and survive the re-heighting; only the props need spots
every conifer has a spot in every direction (some at scale 0.75-0.85); broadleaf may drop

kiln.note: the kiln: the tile's one tall identity piece

shed.note: drying shed with its rows of green bricks

boat.note: fixed: floats at the lake's water level (0.19); spot must be on water, beside a deck/boardwalk

jetty.note: fixed: drop it where the lake town's boardwalks or stilts come within 0.1; never moved

keep.note: the lake town's boardwalks replace the jetty; the boat is fixed (water level) and its spot is always on water
the peaks are the ground mesh itself; Mountains_massif is dropped under the town like any prop

pond.note: ground-bound: the ground mesh is dug for it. Never moves, never dropped; clip any spoke paving over it
